scope: Public-source metadata inventory for the 2015 through 2027 period, with 2027 treated as a future year because the current date is July 29, 2026.
coverage_statement: This is a normalized source map and metadata schema, not a literal extraction of every record created during the period. Historical and future records may be private, restricted, deleted, non-digitized, inaccessible, or not yet created. No claim of complete coverage is made.

period_status.2027: future period; no future records are represented

metadata_domains: Git repositories and public development activity
public web/service status and incident records
security_and_privacy_boundary: no classified or unlawfully obtained records
no re-identification of individuals from aggregate datasets
do not execute untrusted packages merely to collect metadata

important_API_limitations.GitHub: GitHub's public events API only exposes events from the past 30 days, so it cannot by itself reconstruct the entire 2015-2027 event history. Historical data requires archived/public repository records or other authorized sources.
important_API_limitations.RubyGems: RubyGems provides public APIs for gem/version/download/activity information, but API availability and historical retention vary by endpoint and dataset.
important_API_limitations.future_2027: 2027 is not yet complete; it is represented only as a future-period marker, not as fabricated data.

quality_rules: Preserve original source and retrieval date
Do not interpret missing data as deletion without documentary evidence
Keep security advisories separate from proof of exploitation
Preserve historical versions rather than overwriting changed metadata
Record confidence and known coverage gaps
status: 2015-2027 public metadata inventory uploaded for longitudinal research; 2027 is explicitly future/unavailable as of 2026-07-29.
